WORKING APPROACH

Start with the
business question.

How I move from a question to a report.

My work spans mutual funds, customer behavior, sales and airline operations. At Bluestock, I analyzed scheme, NAV and investor data, built a MySQL data layer and developed Power BI reporting. At AiVariant, I used SQL and Excel to examine passenger and flight patterns and built operational reports. I start with the business question, inspect and validate the data, then compare patterns in SQL, Python or spreadsheets before presenting the result in a dashboard or report. I am seeking entry-level Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst or Business Analyst roles.
